the dihydrozones obtained by condensation from the dihyrazide of 5,6-dihydro-1,3,5,2H-thiadiazol-2-thione with aldehydes and ketones exist in solution as a mixture of geometric and conformational isomers.

the dihydrazyde of 1, 3, 4-thiadiazol-2, 5-dithioglukolna acid (I) reacts with aldehydes and ketones in the presence of an acid catalyst, to give the corresponding 2-substituted 5-thioxo-1, 3-thiazolidines (II), which exist in solution as a mixture of geometric and conformational isomers.
dihydrozones, obtained by the condensation of the 2,5-diamino-1,3, 4-thiadiazoline with aldehydes and ketones, are a mixture of stereomers, due to conformation and geometric isomerisms.

the synthesis and properties of the dihydrazone of 1, 3, 4-thiadiazolidine-2, 5-dithiol, which was prepared by the reaction of 1,2-bis(2-oxo-3-oxazolidinyl)-2,2,4,4-tetra-methoxybutane-1,3-diyl dithiol with dihydrazine sulfate.
the synthesis of dihydrozones of 1, 3, 4-thiadiazolidine-2, 5-dithiols and their use as chelating agents.
the development of new synthetic methods for the synthesis of 5,6-dihydro-4H-1,3,5-thiadiazine-2,4-diones and the synthesis of 1,2-dihydro-2-oxo-3H-thiazolo-[3,2-a]-1,3, 5-thiadiazin-3-ones.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dihydrozones, derived from the dihydraide of 1.3.4-thiadiazolo-2,5-diithioglycoilic acid and aldehydes, have the following structure: R-CH=N-CO-NH-NR'-CO-NH-CH=NR' (where R = H or alkyl and R' = H or alk) in solution.
the dihydrozones obtained by condensation with aldehydes exist mainly in the form of the geometric isomer E.
the dihydrozones of 1, 3,4-thiadi-azole-2,5 dithio- glycolic acid dihydrazid, in solutions, are mixtures of stereoisomers, which exist as equilibrium mixtures of geometric and conformational isomers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dihydronaphthoquinone dihydrazides are formed by a reaction of the dihydrazone with the corresponding naphthoquinones, which is accompanied by a change of the dihyrazide structure.

the dihydronaphtalene-1,8-dicarbaldehyde and the dihydronicotinic acid dihydrazone exist in solutions in the form of a single geometric isomer, and all other compounds are mixtures of two geometric isomers.
the dihydazones obtained from the 1,3-dihydrazide of 2,5-dihydroxy-1,3, 4-thiadiazol-2,5-thiol are conformational and geometrical isomer mixtures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dihydronaphthopyran derivatives are promising precursors for the synthesis of 2-arylbenzoxazoles and 2-arylindoles.
the formation of dihydazone molecules is accompanied by a change in the conformational structure of the thiadiazole ring and a change in the orientation of the substituents in the thiadiazolyl ring.
in solutions of dihydazones of the type RCH=N-NHC(=O)-NHC(=S)NH-NHC(=O)NH-CH=N-R', the dihydazone group is present in two isomeric forms: cis and trans, which are in equilibrium with each other.
